question.text: Temporary borrowing arrangements backed by capital commitments from investors:

explanation.text: The Logic: Temporary borrowing arrangements that relate to and are fully covered by investor capital commitments are excluded from the leverage calculation. The Trap: Treating such borrowings as part of leverage would overstate the fund's leverage; they are neither prohibited nor subject to per-transaction SEBI approval. Note: Only borrowings fully covered by capital commitments qualify for this exclusion.
